title: Learning to model other minds
summary: We’re releasing an algorithm which accounts for the fact that other agents are learning too, and discovers self-interested yet collaborative strategies like tit-for-tat in the iterated prisoner’s dilemma. This algorithm, Learning with Opponent-Learning Awareness (LOLA), is a small step towards agents that model other minds.
body: We’re releasing an algorithm which accounts for the fact that other agents are learning too, and discovers self-interested yet collaborative strategies like tit-for-tat in the iterated prisoner’s dilemma. This algorithm, Learning with Opponent-Learning Awareness (LOLA), is a small step towards agents that model other minds.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了LOLA（Learning with Opponent-Learning Awareness）算法，旨在解决多智能体环境下的策略学习问题。该算法通过建模对手的学习过程，使智能体能够发现如“以牙还牙”等自利且协作的策略。这是迈向具备“心智建模”能力的智能体的重要一步，为多智能体博弈研究提供了新思路。

aiReview.reasonZh: 提出了LOLA算法，解决了多智能体学习中对对手策略建模的难题，具有学术价值。

glossary.explanationZh: 一种考虑对手学习行为的强化学习算法。
多智能体系统，涉及多个智能体在同一环境中的交互。
重复囚徒困境，博弈论中的经典协作与背叛模型。
对手建模，指智能体对其他参与者行为模式的预测与分析。
